entry.title: New: Bill 33 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 24-32, AS AMENDED, THE OPERATING BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2025

Decreases revenues in the Transfer to Housing Fund account (-$451,221) and reduces the Housing Production account by the same amount to return funds that could not be applied towards the cost of building materials for two self-help affordable housing projects, due to those building projects being completed after the July 18, 2024, deadline.

Latest action: Council: Bill 33 passes second & final reading - 03/19/2025
